name: Hazelwood (United States)
description: White field with a navy blue triangle at the hoist and a dark red triangle at the fly meeting at the base, for the Missouri and Mississippi rivers coming together, charged with a white birch tree of three green leaves and a black trunk over a black chevron.
history: Hazelwood is a city in St. Louis County, Missouri, within greater St. Louis. The flag was adopted in 1971 (selected from several entries in a city-wide contest in 1971, according to Flags of the World citing the St. Louis Post-Dispatch).

features.role: white birch tree with three green leaves and a black trunk
chevron for the growth of the city
